scope: Same historical u456 deterministic baseline traces, 12 known training scenes, one seed. Counterfactual reward-component rescoring only; actions/trajectories unchanged, not new-policy evaluation or held-out generalization.

gate_reconstruction.active: reset/previous info.active_mask, include own terminal transition, exclude later stale rows
gate_reconstruction.scene: resolved tags free_flow+non_interactive OR family free_flow/parallel_stationary; never infer scene eligibility from prior decision.eligible
gate_reconstruction.forward_speed: recorded reward_diagnostics.closing_speed_mps projected toward own goal
gate_reconstruction.complex: recorded pace_complex_interaction_exempt cross-checked against existing pure family helper
gate_reconstruction.terminal: recorded pace_terminal_exempt from baseline lifecycle; includes success/collision/rule/offroad/timeout/reached/dead semantics
gate_reconstruction.startup_grace: recompute step*timestep <= instant config grace_seconds; same clock as live new environment
gate_reconstruction.near_goal: recompute recorded distance_to_goal_m <= new 5m threshold; old route_pace_v1 near-goal flag is not copied
gate_reconstruction.overspeed: all active pre-step transitions including terminating transition, same continuous speed pure function as environment
gate_reconstruction.missing_gate_handling: cases with unavailable/inconsistent required fields marked incomplete and excluded from aggregate
gate_reconstruction.zero_reason_overlap: exemption/recovery duration categories overlap; do not sum into total duration

instant_pace_spec.parent: v6; replaces free_flow_pace_deficit and inherited overspeed
instant_pace_spec.retained_components: all other v6 components and terminal definitions

pace.direction: actual velocity projected toward route goal; lateral speed alone does not count
pace.clock: elapsed episode seconds only for startup grace; no accumulated pace debt
pace.eligibility: explicit free-flow scene allowlist supplied by caller

overspeed.threshold_meaning: task speed preference; not a claim about legal road speed limit
